title: 那一针 / The Last Stitch
scope: Complete 100-second National Day story; final release includes the forward-pedalling correction.
mode: Original miniature CG narrative created through discussion, preview and revision.
userRequirements: Music + foley + a few Chinese/English captions
Original story, not a copy of the supplied poem video
narrative: A flag beside a present-day window and an old sewing box lead into a remembered workshop. A missing star point is joined, the finished flag is rolled and sent by bicycle, then raised into an afternoon sky. A match cut returns to the little flag and the room, finally revealing a home in the city.

style.direction: Warm, restrained miniature CG. Anonymous sculptural courier. Optical focus, object actions, tracking and continuous cloth deformation.
style.type: Songti SC / STSong for Chinese, Georgia for English; white and warm ivory. Captions remain sparse and do not become slides.
style.camera: Macro stitching; lateral wheel tracking; courier tracking; low-angle rising flag; return to the window. Match the big star into the contemporary small flag.
avoid: Copying reference poem, shots or sound

audioDirection: The sample’s licensed piano/string score, edited into a 100-second arc. Recorded needle/fabric, bicycle and window ambience. No speech. Cloth friction is explicitly a texture proxy for some rope/flutter events.

historicalBasis.supports: The first flag’s large-star corner was joined because the satin width was insufficient. The flag was finished in the early morning and delivered by bicycle.
First flag dimensions 460 x 338 cm, first raised at 15:00 on 1949-10-01; ceremony is shown in afternoon, not sunrise.

creativeBoundary: Modern room, sewing box, needle provenance, exact seam location, workshop, unnamed courier appearance, street and ceremony architecture are narrative interpretations, not documentary reconstructions. No historical dialogue or participant identity is asserted.
referenceUse: Reference was previously analyzed for motion, spatial depth, material and light. No supplied footage, music or poetry is used.
qualityChecks: Key-frame visual inspection of each shot
Measure final audio lag, sample rate and headroom
limitations: Sculptural simplified characters, not realistic human performance
Deterministic cloth deformation, not offline cloth simulation
Signal and timing can be measured, but listening quality is not claimed by the tool workflow
